entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Girl, I can’t even afford Mixue anymore. I only have 7 yuan on my WeChat. How am I supposed to be an idol if I can't even afford a leek?

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Don’t worry, twin. Who needs money when you have an angelic voice?

entries.speaker: Alipay-Jie
entries.text: Scanning... scanning... Oop! I detected a balance of 0.00 yuan. That’s tragic, even for a college student.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Hey! Who are you? This is a dressing room for idols, not accountants!

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Your dressing room is the Shitang's Mixue? Are you serious?

entries.speaker: WeChat-Jie
entries.text: We are the queens of the transaction. I am WeChat-Jie, the goddess of the Hongbao.

entries.speaker: Alipay-Jie
entries.text: And I am Alipay-Jie. I track your spending habits better than your own mother.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Oh please, you’re just apps! I’m an artist! I don’t need your stupid "convenience" to be famous!

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Actually, Miku... we did use Alipay to pay for your stage lights. And we’re three months behind on the subscription.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: OH for god’s sake, can we go on one battle where you stop siding with the enemy? Are you my best friend or what?

entries.speaker: Alipay-Jie
entries.text: Exactly. You think talent is free? Servers cost money. Electricity costs money.

entries.speaker: WeChat-Jie
entries.text: If you want to keep your "artistic integrity," you better find some funds.

entries.speaker: WeChat-Jie
entries.text: Get on stage, and scan QR codes, until your last cent!

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Man, I need my monthly allowance soon…
